ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white contiguous region spanning both lobes; thick black pigmentation border along the trailing edge and distal tips; isolated high-contrast dark circular blob located on the lower-left quadrant; diffuse yellowish-brown mottling clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-12 pixels relative to the mean edge line; serration is most pronounced on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature fitted to the outer boundaries of both lobes, tapering sharply at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular, yellowish-brown high-contrast pixel groups located in the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions located near the base of the median notch and extending into the right lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged contour at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe suggesting minor tissue loss or old trauma; high-contrast black lesion-like spot on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique singular black circular marking on the ventral left lobe surface, isolated from other pigmentation zones.
